treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the Sultanate of Oman for the avoidance of double taxation (2003; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 6 October 2003. Entry into Force: 7 April 2006. Effective Date: 1 January 2007. Art. 27(a)(i): in the Sultanate of Oman in respect of taxes withheld at source: for amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of January next following the date on which this Agreement enters into force
source_title: IRAS consolidated text: Singapore-Oman DTA (ratified)(MLI)(1 Nov 2020), incl. Protocol 2003 and Annex A MLI effects

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed five (5) per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed seven (7) percent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed eight (8) percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ... (Annex A para 7(b)(i): taxes withheld at source ... on or after 1 January 2021)

notes: MLI deleted the treaty main-purpose clauses Art. 10(8), 11(9), 12(7) and added the PPT. Not modelled: dividends and interest paid to the Government (incl. Central Bank of Oman, State General Reserve Fund, Oman Development Bank, MAS, GIC) exempt (Art. 10(3)-(4), 11(3)-(4)). A separate limited DTA (international air transport) is superseded per Protocol para 3 except its Protocol. MLI Art. 8 not applied.
